newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Summarecon to list unit this year.
newsitem.headline: Summarecon to list unit this year.

text.p: Indonesian property firm Summarecon Agung said on Tuesday it planned to list its subsidiary PT Jakarta Baru Cosmopolitan in the third quarter of 1997.
Summarecon corporate secretary Michael Yong said the company was discussing the details with the underwriter and preparing to inform the Capital Market Supervisory Agency (Bapepam).

"I cannot give you the details now because we are still discussing with the underwriter. We are now preparing a formal letter to be sent to the stock exchange body about this plan," Yong told Reuters.
Summarecon has been actively traded on talk that the company might acquire a property firm. On Tuesday, it rose 50 rupiah to 1,300 on 3.4 million shares.
Yong said the market talk was incorrect.
He said the firm was planning to launch two projects this year in the Kelapa Gading area in north Jakarta, involving the construction of an apartment block and commercial building.
But he declined to give details, saying the firm would detail the projects at an analysts' briefing later this month.
Yong said the company expected an eight to nine percent profit growth for 1997. The company is targeted to book a net profit of 38 billion rupiah in 1996, he said.
